msg: warning: Variable ch is used uninitialized!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: bc0ffc0e971.c (BusyBox nameif). Alarm fires at line 29 ('ch = malloc(sizeof(*ch))'), condition True. The tool claims 'ch is used uninitialized' because of the 'sizeof(*ch)' expression. However, sizeof evaluates the TYPE of its operand at compile time, not the runtime value — it does not dereference ch or read its value. The real issue on this line is the missing NULL check after malloc (ch could be NULL before line 30 dereferences it), but that is a different bug than uninitialized value.
